description: This source file defines an Android activity named AnimationLoading, demonstrating loading and running various Animator objects from XML resources. It includes an inner class MyAnimationView that manages animated shapes (balls) and their animations, including loading Animator resources, setting up animation sequences, and rendering animated graphics on a Canvas.

classes.name: AnimationLoading
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating loading Animator objects from XML and managing animated views.

classes.name: MyAnimationView
classes.description: Inner class extending View, responsible for drawing animated circles and managing Animator objects for animations.

classes.name: ShapeHolder
classes.description: Custom utility class (not fully visible but implied) used to hold shape drawable objects along with position and color information.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, and binds button to start animations.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Lazy loads and sets up all Animator objects from XML resources, configures their targets and update listeners, and combines them into an AnimatorSet.

methods.name: startAnimation
methods.description: Starts the animator sequence for the animation view.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Adds a ball with specified position and color, creating RadialGradient shader for the paint.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws all the balls on the canvas at their current positions.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Updates the Y position of the first ball based on the animation progress and requests canvas redraw.
